# Review Checklist

## Content Quality

- Scope is clear
- Claims are technically correct
- Terminology is consistent with glossary
- Risks and assumptions are explicit

## Traceability

- Critical statements have sources
- Review date and owner are present
- Related chapters are linked where needed

## Operability

- Actionable guidance is present
- Runbook implications are clear
- Test impact is documented for changes

## Decision

- Approved
- Approved with changes
- Rejected with required fixes
